therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with early active rheumatoid arthritis
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in DAS28-ESR at Week 48

results.effect_size: DAS28-ESR mean change: -1.5; ESR mean change: -24.7 mm/hr; HAQ-DI mean change: -0.9
biomarker_changes: ESR mean change from baseline: -24.7 mm/hr at Week 48
subgroup_findings: SF-36 Physical Health Score mean change: +14.5 (improvement)
SF-36 Mental Health Score mean change: -1.2 (worsening)
safety_signals: Serious adverse events included hypoxia, laryngospasm, and pulmonary oedema (each in 1/4 participants); trial terminated due to unfavorable risk-benefit ratio in early RA

dose_info.schedule: Two infusions 14 days apart (Day 0 and Week 2)

context.investigator_commentary: The perceived risk-benefit ratio for individuals with early active RA led to trial termination.

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Methotrexate co-administration may enhance rituximab's B-cell depletion and anti-inflammatory effects by suppressing lymphocyte proliferation and reducing immunogenicity, but the trial was too small and terminated early to demonstrate this interaction.
modulation_entries.citation: Concomitant treatments to be administered at a dose and frequency prescribed per protocol include methotrexate (MTX) and folic or folinic acid.
